title: Bridge Works
tagline: Truss bridge builder on a real direct-stiffness solver — cheapest surviving bridge wins
hub_blurb: Build a truss, watch the real solver expose tension, buckling, and collapse, then compete for the cheapest bridge that survives.
card_blurb: Truss bridge builder on a real direct-stiffness solver: live tension and compression, Euler buckling, progressive collapse. Cheapest bridge that survives wins.
description: **Bridge Works** — truss bridge builder for physics class. Real direct-stiffness truss solver, live tension/compression colouring, Euler buckling, progressive collapse, five levels with golf-style par budgets plus a sandbox. Includes a printable teacher guide.
